config.hypothesis:
Characterization only. Genesis should be measured, not tuned to force survival.
The campaign quantifies longevity, extinction, physical energy balance, hazard
damage, movement and dispersion across deterministic seeds.
config.success_criteria:
No survival pass/fail threshold. Scientific validity requires deterministic
replay, closed physical accounting, clean World architecture and complete
reporting of all seeds and founders.
config.title: Genesis Viability Characterization
